title: Seeding clouds with seawater could prevent a super El Niño
description: A modelling study suggests marine cloud brightening could shade the eastern Pacific and reduce a global temperature spike from El Niño, but there could be unexpected consequences
author: Alec Luhn

title: Our fertility window could be extended by making ovaries softer
description: A drug that softens the ovaries helped mice and rats conceive more easily at an older age, and produce more pups
author: Tosin Thompson

title: Lambs born via IVF using highly immature eggs in major breakthrough
description: Lambs have been born using an experimental form of IVF that coaxes immature eggs to become mature ones. This could boost the number of eggs available for fertilisation and improve IVF success rates
author: Carissa Wong

title: The allergy culprit histamine also boosts our memory
description: A drug that raises levels of histamine – the chemical that causes allergy symptoms – in the brain boosts our memory by around 10 per cent
author: Michael Le Page

title: How extreme heat affects the body – and the best ways to cope
description: A short spell in a heat chamber at the University of Brighton showed Alec Luhn that his body is not adapted to high temperatures – but regular exposure can train the body to respond more effectively
author: Alec Luhn

title: Peter Shor’s algorithm could break the internet – but he's not worried
description: Few people have invented an algorithm with the potential to spark a worldwide crisis, so why is quantum computing pioneer Peter Shor so unconcerned? Karmela Padavic-Callaghan spoke to him to find out
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan
